c74object.name: sunny.lfo~
c74object.description: Generate one mono low-frequency oscillator signal. Message controls are serialized outside the audio callback and take effect in order at the next signal-vector boundary.

objarg.name: frequency
objarg.digest: Set the initial frequency in hertz

method.name: frequency
method.description: Accept a finite nonnegative frequency no greater than the active sample rate.

method.name: waveform
method.description: Choose sine, triangle, saw, square, or random.

method.name: phase
method.description: Accept a finite phase greater than or equal to 0 and less than 1.

method.name: status
method.description: Post configuration, setup, control, current pending-control, process, and last-error evidence to the Max console. The right message outlet also emits the closed tuple `host_status configured sample_rate maximum_frames process_observed process_calls last_frame_count process_healthy last_error`; `process_calls` is an exact signed saturating callback count and the left outlet remains the sole signal outlet.

method.name: clear_error
method.description: Clear the last-error code without clearing counters or DSP state.
